_comment: Statements the one-off runner (apps/migrate/run-statement.mjs) may run on a deployed database. A statement is reviewed by the pull request that adds it here; it can be run once a deploy has built it into the migrate image. They live under apps/migrate, not docs, because a change under docs/ starts no deploy. Each placeholder __NAME__ in the file is declared under params with a type (uuid, slug, reference) and filled from OCI_SQL_PARAM_NAME at launch. writes: false runs in a READ ONLY transaction. Guide: docs/runbooks/one-off-sql.md.
